title: What's new in BrickVerse Creator
subtitle: Build richer worlds with expanded geometry, terrain, UI, voice, scripting, debugging, and Creator workflows.

sections.title: A much larger DataModel
sections.body: More familiar building blocks are available directly in Creator and Luau.
items: New Attachment, Beam, Trail, Highlight, SurfaceAppearance, SpawnLocation, VehicleSeat, SoundGroup, ClickDetector, and DragDetector instances
New Hinge, BallSocket, Spring, Rope, Slider, Motor, AlignPosition, AlignRotation, and Prismatic constraints
New ColorCorrection, Bloom, Fog, Ambient Occlusion, and Tonemap post-processing effects
Decals can attach to a selected part face, while UIGradient can target backgrounds, text, strokes, and borders
Instance attributes add SetAttribute, GetAttribute, removal, enumeration, and change signals

sections.title: Geometry, unions, and faster shape creation
sections.body: Creator now provides more ways to construct reusable geometry without leaving the viewport.
items: Union, negate, unmerge, and geometry operations support Parts, Meshes, and EditableMeshes through Creator context menus
Unstable union tooling is protected by its beta feature enrollment and produces smoother, double-sided results
Negated geometry is visibly translucent in edit mode so boolean operations are easier to understand
New configurable Icosphere geometry supports multiple subdivision and face-count levels
The ribbon's new Shapes dropdown quickly inserts blocks, spheres, cylinders, cones, wedges, corner wedges, toruses, trusses, frames, and icospheres with undo and snapping

sections.title: New beta: Skinned Terrain Grass
sections.body: Paint performant, animated grass directly onto terrain with global and per-stroke art direction.
items: Paint and erase GPU-instanced grass from the Terrain Editor
Control density, blade height, width, variation, draw distance, base color, and tip color
Override density, size, and tint at each painted location instead of relying only on global values
Optionally conform and deform blades to terrain surfaces with adjustable surface inset
Grass animation now follows Environment wind direction, strength, and speed

sections.title: Voice, chat, and safer communication
sections.body: Experiences can offer richer communication while respecting account eligibility, blocking, and local controls.
items: VoiceChatService provides spatial Opus voice for eligible 13+ users in voice-enabled experiences
Voice activity bubbles show microphone input above players and allow quick local mute or microphone toggling
Blocked users cannot be heard, and Luau can control microphone state, sensitivity, per-player mute, volume, indicators, and voice events
ChatChannel and SlashCommand instances add custom channels, team chat, local commands, permissions, prefixes, and autofill
Whispers, friendship and block integration, grouped quick-chat phrases, and a quick-chat wheel improve communication access

sections.title: Developer-defined game settings
sections.body: Creators can add experience-specific options to the player's redesigned pause menu.
items: Create ordered GameSetting instances with custom categories, titles, descriptions, stable keys, and defaults
Choose boolean, number slider, text, dropdown choice, keybind, or color controls
Per-universe values persist locally for each player and expose typed Luau getters, setters, reset, and change signals
The new left-side game menu keeps gameplay visible and opens responsive content panels only when needed
Controls jumps directly to the experience's Game settings category, while narrow and short windows use compact adaptive layouts

sections.title: Creator workflow improvements
sections.body: Common editing and testing actions take fewer steps and behave more predictably.
items: The Insert menu is searchable, scrollable, and automatically includes all creatable instance types
Shift or Ctrl selection can target a part inside a model instead of always selecting the entire model
Ctrl+L switches transform orientation, with global and local gizmo alignment available from Creator settings
A welding workflow makes it easier to connect selected parts and configure constraints
Play tests can attach to the active Creator viewport or launch as independent resizable windows, without unexpectedly minimizing

sections.title: A richer Toolbox
sections.body: Inspect assets before committing them to a project and place them exactly where they belong.
items: Single-clicking an asset opens a detailed modal instead of inserting immediately
Asset details include descriptions, comments and reviews, purchase, insert, and report actions
Supported models can be inspected in an interactive 3D viewport preview
Double-click preserves the fast insert workflow
Drag assets onto Explorer targets such as ScriptService to choose their parent

sections.title: Expanded Luau and networking
sections.body: Roblox-style APIs reduce boilerplate while keeping existing networking workflows compatible.
items: The task library adds wait, spawn, defer, delay, cancel, synchronization helpers, and legacy wait/spawn compatibility
Network events accept normal Luau values through InvokeServer and automatically serialize supported payloads
The original NetMessage builder remains supported for explicit typed messages
Editor completion and generated Luau definitions cover more globals, services, instances, properties, methods, signals, and enums
Luau profiling infrastructure supplies runtime script timing data to Creator debugging tools

sections.title: Developer Console and diagnostics
sections.body: The F8 console has evolved into a broader runtime investigation workspace.
items: New executor tooling runs diagnostic Luau against an active play test
Script Profiler views expose execution timing and hotspots
Memory, world, network, player, instance, and runtime information are available from developer tools
Runtime debug windows stream logs and state back into Creator
Editor diagnostics and property controls handle more DataModel types, including editable string arrays

sections.title: More world systems and media
sections.body: New runtime systems cover navigation, video, advertising, rendering, and vehicle interactions.
items: PathfindingService, PathfindingPath, and NavigationLink add blocked-path reporting and explicit traversal links
UIVideoFrame supports optimized video playback through the asset pipeline
UIAd and AdService support display and video placements with eligibility and rate-limited impression handling
ShaderEffect provides a constrained instance-based visual effect workflow instead of unrestricted custom shader execution
Internal anti-cheat checks cover suspicious movement, network behavior, invalid state, and memory anomalies, with universe-level enablement
